name: Brown Bear
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy brown bear with thick tawny fur, broad shoulders, and short rounded ears.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 350. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775806-brown-bear
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
Claw. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by Claw becomes Prone.

appearance: A tall, pale sandy camel with a single shaggy hump, long legs, and a curved neck.

sections.Actions: Bite. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Cat
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3 and Stealth +4. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A small short-haired tabby with a striped brown-gray coat, cream throat, and upright ears.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 351. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775808-cat
sections.Traits: Jumper. Determine the cat’s jump distance with Dexterity in place of Strength.
sections.Actions: Scratch. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 Slashing damage.

name: Constrictor Snake
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2 and Stealth +4. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy-bodied brown snake with dark saddle-shaped markings and a broad head.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 351. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775809-constrictor-snake
sections.Actions:
Bite. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
Constrict. One Medium or smaller creature the snake can see within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 7 (3d4) Bludgeoning damage and becomes Grappled (escape DC 12).
